extends: CA2-2 (catalogo_contratos.json, ca2.precision_rule_fields / precision_kinds / selector_rule_fields), which remains active and unchanged
scope: payload of precision_rule inside a CA2 evidence receipt with role 'precision'; the receipt envelope (facts, outcome, precision_rule, common_conflicts) is unchanged

dispatch.rule_without_contract_version: CA2-2 semantics: one kind per receipt, one rounding unit per member selector; never re-read per primitive
dispatch.rule_with_contract_version=CA2-2X-PRECIS: semantics below; the active CA2-2 validator rejects it (different field set), so no consumer can accept it silently

kind.rule: mixed iff primitives contain both rounding and exact; otherwise the single kind present

primitive_fields.value: stored literal (canonical decimal); '0' for a documented exact zero read from a blank cell
primitive_fields.rounding_unit: canonical positive decimal in the file unit for rounding; null for exact
primitive_fields.domain: [low, high] canonical decimals; rounding: exactly [value - unit/2, value + unit/2] (closed envelope, no tie rule assumed); exact: [0, 0]
primitive_fields.rule_id: id in the sealed dossier reglas_publicacion.json
primitive_fields.evidence_ids: non-empty list of current DB-02 evidence ids resolved for this primitive (rule claim and, for concept-level rules, the concept-cell correspondence claim)
primitive_fields.status: ok | pending_review (an emitted PASS receipt must contain only ok)

selector_rule_fields.selector: member selector exactly as in facts.selectors (same order)
selector_rule_fields.terms: [[primitive, coefficient], ...] exactly the parse of the member selector; a composite member can never be a single cell
selector_rule_fields.member_domain: affine propagation of the term domains after grouping identical primitives (shared primitives cancel exactly)
selector_rule_fields.rule_locator: dossier seal prefix and rule ids

shared_denominator.primitives: its primitives; every share of the vector uses this same assignment

consumer_checks: exact field sets at every level
primitive domain recomputed from value and unit; value on the declared increment
exact primitive: value 0, unit null, domain [0,0]; with cells, stored cell blank or 0
with cells: rounded primitive equals the stored value of a non-formula cell
terms equal the member selector parse; member domain equals the grouped affine propagation
every primitive used by some member; shared denominator equals the GDP member terms
emitted PASS receipts contain no primitive pending review
